description: This PHP source file defines the Tasks class for PostgreSQL database installation and configuration within Drupal, including connection handling, extension checks, and database setup functions.

classes.name: Tasks
classes.description: Defines installation and configuration tasks for PostgreSQL databases in Drupal, including version checks, connection tests, extension checks, and database initialization.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the database type, 'PostgreSQL'.

methods.name: minimumVersion
methods.description: Returns the minimum required PostgreSQL version, '16'.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the database, with fallback logic to create the database if it does not exist.

methods.name: checkEncoding
methods.description: Checks if the database encoding is UTF-8.

methods.name: checkBinaryOutput
methods.description: Checks and sets the bytea_output setting to 'escape' for binary data handling.

methods.name: checkBinaryOutputSuccess
methods.description: Verifies if the bytea_output setting is correctly set to 'escape'.

methods.name: checkStandardConformingStringsSuccess
methods.description: Verifies if the standard_conforming_strings setting is 'on'.

methods.name: checkExtensions
methods.description: Checks if the pg_trgm extension is enabled in PostgreSQL.

methods.name: initializeDatabase
methods.description: Creates necessary functions in the database to make Drupal compatible with PostgreSQL.

methods.name: getFormOptions
methods.description: Provides form options for database configuration, setting default port if not specified.
